mapper.select: SELECT r.CHAT_ROOM_NO, r.CHAT_ROOM_NM FROM CHAT_ROOM r INNER JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER m ON (r.CHAT_ROOM_NO = m.CHAT_ROOM_NO) WHERE m.USER_NO = #{userNo} AND m.LEFT_DTTM IS NULL

SELECT m.CHAT_MSG_NO, m.CHAT_ROOM_NO, m.MSG_TY_CD, m.MSG_CN, m.ATCH_FILE_ID, m.REG_DTTM, m.SENDER_TY, m.CHAT_MEMBER_ID, rm.USER_NO FROM CHAT_MESSAGE m JOIN CHAT_ROOM_MEMBER rm ON m.CHAT_MEMBER_ID = rm.CHAT_MEMBER_ID WHERE m.CHAT_ROOM_NO = #{chatRoomNo} ORDER BY m.REG_DTTM ASC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_CHAT_MESSAGE.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO CHAT_MESSAGE ( CHAT_MSG_NO, CHAT_ROOM_NO, MSG_TY_CD, MSG_CN, CHAT_MEMBER_ID, REG_DTTM ) VALUES ( #{chatMsgNo}, #{chatRoomNo}, #{msgTyCd}, #{msgCn}, #{chatMemberId}, SYSDATE )
